title: Software Developer (Node.js & Angular)
description:
Job Description Software Developer (Node.js, Angular & PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB) Position: Software Developer – Node.js & Angular
 Experience: 3+ Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Work Location: Karol Bagh, New Delhi 
 Company: Nucleus Microsystems / M2Cloud
 Company Website: M2Cloud
 Department: Software Development About the Role We are looking for an experienced Full-Stack Software Developer with strong hands-on experience in Node.js, Angular, PostgreSQL, and TimescaleDB . The selected candidate will be responsible for developing and maintaining a Node.js-based middleware/API platform , a modern Angular web application , and database-driven business modules. The role involves developing custom modules including user management, inventory, reporting, payment processing, API integrations, dashboards, and time-series data functionality. Key Responsibilities 1. Node.js Backend & Middleware Development Develop and maintain scalable backend applications using Node.js . Design and develop RESTful APIs for frontend and third-party applications. Develop middleware/API services for integrating multiple systems and services. Implement JWT-based authentication and authorization . Develop user management, roles, permissions, and access control. Develop custom modules including:
 User Management Customer Management Inventory Management Device/Asset Management Reports Notifications and Alerts Configuration and Settings Subscription/Service Management Other custom application modules Develop GET, POST, PUT and DELETE APIs for third-party integrations. Implement API validation, authentication, error handling, logging, and security. Optimize backend performance and API response times. 2. PostgreSQL & TimescaleDB Develop and maintain applications using PostgreSQL . Work with TimescaleDB for time-series and telemetry data. Design efficient database schemas for transactional and time-series data. Develop complex SQL queries, joins, aggregations, and database operations. Work with large volumes of time-series data. Understand TimescaleDB hypertables, chunks, retention policies, and time-based queries . Optimize database queries and indexes. Implement data retention and archival strategies. Troubleshoot database performance and connectivity issues. Maintain data integrity and transaction consistency. 3. Payment Gateway Integration Integrate and maintain online payment gateways with Node.js and Angular applications. Implement payment initiation, transaction processing, and payment status management. Integrate payment gateway APIs and SDKs. Implement secure payment callbacks and webhooks . Handle successful, failed, cancelled, pending, and expired transactions. Implement server-side transaction verification. Maintain payment transaction records and history. Implement refund and transaction-status functionality where supported. Handle payment reconciliation. Experience with Razorpay, PayU, Cashfree, Stripe, or similar gateways is an advantage. 4. Angular Frontend Development Develop responsive web applications using Angular and TypeScript . Build frontend modules consuming APIs from the Node.js middleware. Develop dashboards, forms, tables, reports, charts, and administrative interfaces. Develop payment-related screens and transaction interfaces. Implement JWT-based authentication and session management. Implement role-based access and permissions. Develop reusable Angular components, services, and modules. Integrate REST APIs using RxJS and Angular services. Debug and optimize frontend performance. 5. API & Third-Party Integration Design and develop APIs for external application integration. Integrate third-party APIs and services. Work extensively with REST APIs and JSON . Implement secure API authentication and authorization. Integrate payment, notification, communication, and other external services. Prepare and maintain API documentation. Troubleshoot API and data synchronization issues. Mandatory Requirements The candidate must have professional hands-on experience with all of the following : Node.js – Backend and REST API development Angular – Frontend application development PostgreSQL – Database development and SQL TimescaleDB – Time-series data REST API development and third-party integrations JWT authentication and authorization Payment gateway integration Git-based development workflow Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience Candidates with experience limited to only Node.js or only Angular will not be considered. Technical Skills Backend Node.js Express.js or equivalent framework REST API development JWT authentication Role-based authorization JSON Asynchronous programming API security Error handling and logging Frontend Angular TypeScript HTML5 CSS3 Angular Services Angular Routing Reactive Forms REST API integration RxJS Responsive web development Database PostgreSQL TimescaleDB SQL Database design CRUD operations Joins and aggregations Indexing Query optimization Time-series data management Database transactions Payment Integration Payment gateway API/SDK integration Payment callbacks and webhooks Transaction verification Payment status handling Refund processing Transaction reconciliation Preferred Additional Skills Experience with the following will be an advantage: IoT / telematics / asset-management applications Large-scale time-series data Razorpay, PayU, Cashfree, Stripe or similar payment gateways Subscription and recurring payment systems Real-time applications WebSockets Docker Nginx Linux server administration Cloud/VPS deployment Firebase / push notifications Swagger/OpenAPI CI/CD Postman Data visualization and reporting libraries Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should: Have 3+ years of professional software development experience . Be comfortable working across both backend and frontend development. Have experience building complete features from database Node.js API Angular frontend . Have experience with third-party API and payment gateway integration. Understand authentication, authorization, and application security. Be capable of independently developing, testing, debugging, and deploying application modules. Have strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Be comfortable working with an existing codebase and extending functionality. Have good communication and documentation skills. Key Deliverables The developer will contribute to: Node.js middleware and API platform Angular web application PostgreSQL and TimescaleDB development User and role management Inventory and asset management Reporting modules Dashboards and administrative interfaces Payment gateway integration Third-party API integrations Custom business modules API documentation Testing, debugging, and performance optimization Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent practical software development experience may also be considered. Work Location Karol Bagh, New Delhi This is an office-based, full-time position . The selected candidate will be required to work from the company's office in Karol Bagh, New Delhi. Company: Nucleus Microsystems / M2Cloud

title: Front-End Engineer
description:
Auditmann is a SaaS-based software platform designed for CA firms in India to simplify and automate their day-to-day accounting, auditing, and tax-related tasks. The platform aims to streamline processes such as Schedule III financial statement preparation, TDS, GST and Income Tax audit procedures, and automatic generation of Tax Audit Reports , helping CA firms improve efficiency, accuracy, and productivity. We are looking for a Front-End Engineer who can both design and build a modern, intuitive, and scalable user interface for Auditmann's SaaS platform. This is not a pure implementation role, we expect the candidate to think through UI/UX decisions themselves, not just execute designs handed to them. 
 Key Responsibilities Design and develop responsive, user-friendly, and visually appealing web interfaces for the Auditmann SaaS platform, end to end, from concept to code. Independently design screen layouts, workflows, and component structures for new features, rather than relying solely on a separate design team or pre-made mockups. Develop reusable and scalable UI components using Next.js and modern front-end technologies . Translate business requirements directly into well-designed, functional, high-quality web applications , making sound UI/UX decisions along the way. Work closely with the product and backend teams to define and create smooth, intuitive user experiences. Integrate front-end applications with REST APIs and other backend services . Manage application state effectively using Redux or other state-management solutions . Ensure consistency in UI components, layouts, navigation, forms, dashboards, tables, and data-heavy screens. Optimize applications for performance, responsiveness, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility . Identify and resolve UI/UX issues, bugs, and performance bottlenecks. Take ownership of the overall usability and user experience of the platform, not just its implementation. Collaborate with the team to continuously improve existing features and design new product functionalities. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern front-end development . Hands-on experience with Next.js and React.js. Solid grasp of UI/UX principles and the ability to design clean, usable interfaces independently, not just code from a provided design. Understanding of REST APIs, API integration, request/response handling, and authentication . Good understanding of Redux and state management concepts . Experience working with reusable UI components and design systems. Understanding of Git/version control and basic software development workflows. Ability to go from a rough idea or requirement straight to a functional, well-designed interface, with or without a wireframe provided. Good problem-solving and debugging skills. Ability to work in a startup environment and take ownership of assigned tasks. 
 Good to Have Experience working on SaaS products, dashboards, or B2B applications . Experience with accounting, taxation, audit, or finance-related software. Proficiency in Figma or similar design tools, for prototyping and design handoff. Knowledge of TypeScript. Experience with UI component libraries such as Material UI, Ant Design, Shadcn, Tailwind CSS , etc. Understanding of basic accessibility and web performance practices. 
 What You'll Work On As part of the product development team, you will design and build interfaces for features such as: Financial statement preparation dashboards Schedule III financial statements TDS, GST & Income Tax audit workflows Tax Audit Report generation Client and engagement management Data-entry and review interfaces Reports, tables and analytics dashboards Automated task/workflow management CA firm and client-facing dashboards 
 Ideal Candidate We're looking for someone who is strong technically but also thinks like a designer , someone who doesn't just wait for a Figma file, but can look at a complex business requirement and independently work out the simplest, most intuitive interface to solve it, then build it. Since Auditmann is a startup, the candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, taking ownership of both design and engineering decisions, experimenting with solutions, and collaborating closely with the founding/product team . 
 Why Join Booksmann? Opportunity to work on a real-world SaaS product solving problems for CA firms across India. Full ownership over both the design and the code of what you build, not just implementation. Work closely with the product and technology team. Fast-paced startup environment with opportunities to learn and grow. Opportunity to work on complex FinTech/TaxTech and automation use cases .

Key Skills: Front End Engineering,Ui/Ux,Software Development,Frontend Development,UI Development,Designing UI
